name: Mac disk guard for the Colima VM's sparse disk images (Mac launchd daemon)
purpose: since 2026-11-10 launchd com.powstation.disk-guard (PowStation/scripts/disk-guard.sh, root, every 30 s) watches free space on /System/Volumes/Data, where the Colima VM's sparse disk images grow: alerts below 60 GB (PowDash's Discord webhook + Mac powos comms via PowStation/scripts/pow-alert.sh), SIGSTOPs stickman trainers and pauses sheddable containers (sabnzbd) below 25 GB (resumed at 30), deletes its 10 GB ballast ~/.colima/pow-disk-ballast below 12 GB, and below 3 GB freezes (SIGSTOP) the VM's Virtualization.framework process so its ext4 never sees a failed write (resumed at 8 GB). HACK until the VM images get their own APFS volume with -reserve. Docs: PowStation/docs/vm-self-healing.md
installedBy: sudo cp PowStation/scripts/com.powstation.disk-guard.plist /Library/LaunchDaemons/ && sudo launchctl bootstrap system /Library/LaunchDaemons/com.powstation.disk-guard.plist
unbounded: macOS has no cgroups; a short bash pass every 30 s (df, two stat calls, an lsof only at <25 GB); 10 GB ballast file, created only when free >= 75 GB
